an4.50:1.1: “Monks, there are these four obscurations of the sun and moon, obscured by which the sun and moon don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:1.3: “Clouds are an obscuration of the sun and moon, obscured by which the sun and moon don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:4.1: “Rāhu, the king of the asuras [believed to be the cause of an eclipse] is an obscuration of the sun and moon, obscured by which the sun and moon don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:4.2: “These are the four obscurations of the sun and moon, obscured by which the sun and moon don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:5.1: “In the same way, there are four obscurations of contemplatives & brahmans, obscured by which some contemplatives & brahmans don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:5.3: “There are some contemplatives & brahmans who drink alcohol and fermented liquor, who don’t refrain from drinking alcohol and fermented liquor.
an4.50:5.4: This is the first obscuration of contemplatives & brahmans, obscured by which some contemplatives & brahmans don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:6.1: “There are some contemplatives & brahmans who engage in sexual intercourse, who don’t refrain from sexual intercourse.
an4.50:6.2: This is the second obscuration of contemplatives & brahmans, obscured by which some contemplatives & brahmans don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:7.1: “There are some contemplatives & brahmans who consent to gold & silver, who don’t refrain from accepting gold & silver.
an4.50:7.2: This is the third obscuration of contemplatives & brahmans, obscured by which some contemplatives & brahmans don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:8.1: “There are some contemplatives & brahmans who maintain life through wrong livelihood, who don’t refrain from wrong livelihood.
an4.50:8.2: This is the fourth obscuration of contemplatives & brahmans, obscured by which some contemplatives & brahmans don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.
an4.50:8.3: “These are the four obscurations, obscured by which some contemplatives & brahmans don’t glow, don’t shine, don’t dazzle.”
